text:
Maya Chen: quick sync: drafting a compact rollout playbook for v3 text-gen canary. need traffic split, session pinning, rollback triggers, and experiment signals. Kevin/Olga/Samir please chime.

Kevin Park: suggest deterministic sampling (hash by user_id) + session pin duration. also account for cache warm-up before latency checks.

Maya Chen: yes to deterministic sampling. default pin 24h, configurable for Dedicated.

Samir Joshi: add explicit quality rollback rules. not just errors/latency.

Maya Chen: propose automatic rollback if: 1) >3 failing prompts from canary-eval-200 in rolling 30m OR 2) >5% drop in similarity metric over same window. minor regressions -> pause + alert.

Olga Petrov: infra constraints: Hosted -> edge hashing ok. Dedicated -> pin by org-id. limit concurrent canaries per region to 2. we need DB schema for pin metadata (pin_version, pin_expires_at).

Lia Martinez: A/B design: split by request type (chat vs completion), capture tokens per request, log sample bucket and experiment id header.

Maya Chen: draft playbook snippet below, please review quickly.

```
canary_version: "v3"
sampling_strategy: "deterministic_hash(user_id)"
stages:
  - pct: 0.5
    duration: 10m
  - pct: 5
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 25
    duration: 2h
pinning:
  default: "24h"
  allow_per_customer_override: true
checks:
  latency_p95_ms: 800
  error_rate_pct: 1.0
  eval_set: "canary-eval-200"
  quality_fail_count: 3
  similarity_drop_pct: 5
warmup_delay: 5m  # only measure latency after warmup
circuit_breaker: on_gpu_oom_or_node_fail -> rollback
logs: include x-redwood-experiment-id, sample_bucket
```

Kevin Park: add note to only start latency windows after warmup_delay. also include Grafana panel links and alert IDs in final doc.

Olga Petrov: infra OK pending small migration window. I'll post the pin storage plan.

Samir Joshi: acceptance criteria for GA after canary: p95 < 700ms for 24h, error_rate < 0.5% for 24h, <=2 eval failures on core set, cost delta <= +10% per 1k tokens. Dedicated needs a 24h locked cohort before GA.

Maya Chen: next steps: 1) I'll update PRD with Grafana links and panel IDs by EOD. 2) Kevin to validate warm-up & circuit-breaker tests. 3) Samir finalize eval checklist. 4) Olga to share migration plan.

deploy-bot: deploy started for v3 canary (stage 0.5%) ts:1750124700. monitor: /console/canaries/v3

Kevin Park: watching infra. small ask: include exact alert IDs and runbook links.

Maya Chen: will add runbook links and then merge RFC once approvals in. :rocket:
